description: This file contains utility functions for creating various OpenGL textures, including 2D textures, cubemaps, and mipmapped textures, using OpenGL API calls.

methods.name: CreateSimpleTexture2D
methods.description: Creates a simple 2x2 RGB texture with red, green, blue, and yellow pixels, sets texture parameters, and returns the texture ID.

methods.name: CreateSimpleTextureCubemap
methods.description: Creates a cubemap texture with six colored faces (red, green, blue, yellow, purple, white), sets texture parameters, and returns the texture ID.

methods.name: CreateMipMappedTexture2D
methods.description: Creates a 256x256 checkerboard pattern texture, generates mipmaps, sets texture parameters, and returns the texture ID.
